svg.title: How the German documentation stays in step
svg.desc: README.md and README.de.md link to each other. The English pages of the website, such as guide.md, take their snippets from README.md, and the German ones, such as guide.de.md, from README.de.md; an English page shows the diagram NAME.mmd, its German twin NAME.de.mmd. scripts/check-project.sh compares the outline of each German page with that of its English twin. MkDocs builds the English website and, with the plugin i18n, the German one in de/, with a language switch in the header. The English sources are blue, the German ones orange, the check and the website green.
